sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球海事商船注册旗国、借鉴特拉华州公司法的非公开发行实体

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: None (no comprehensive bilateral investment treaty or double taxation agreement currently in force)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Financing of Terrorism Act 2012 (Title 31, RMI Code, Pub. L. No. 2012-21, as amended); Business Corporations Act 1990 (Title 51, RMI Code, as amended); and the General Associations Law. Beneficial ownership information is collected by licensed registered agents under Section 45 of the AML/CFT Act and is not filed with a public registry.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of the beneficial owner's passport (bio-data page)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing authority or notary public in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization via the Marshall Islands Embassy or authorized consular officer

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement not older than 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Public utility provider or issuing financial institution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization via the Marshall Islands Embassy or authorized consular officer

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified bank reference letter confirming the corporate account relationship and source of funds
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing commercial bank at the owner's primary residence or place of business
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization via the Marshall Islands Embassy or authorized consular officer

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of each beneficial owner, director, and authorized signatory against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, and the domestic consolidated list maintained by the Marshall Islands Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU). Enhanced due diligence is required for politically exposed persons (PEPs), their family members, and close associates, as defined under Section 2.1 of the AML/CFT Act 2012, including a mandatory source-of-wealth declaration and senior-management approval. Screening must be completed within 24 hours of engagement initiation and re-run on a rolling 90-day basis through an automated compliance system.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Republic of the Marshall Islands – Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Corporate Registry Online Portal (maintained within the Ministry of Finance and Banking)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All name reservation submissions must be made in the English language using the standard Latin (A-Z) alphabet. The name must be legible, searchable, and expressed in English characters. Foreign-script names are not accepted; any foreign-language name must be transliterated into English and must not be misleadingly similar to any existing registered name. The proposed name must include a corporate identifier (e.g., 'Corporation', 'Inc.', 'Limited', or corresponding abbreviation) as required under Section 22 of the Business Corporations Act.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If a name is rejected, the applicant or its licensed registered agent may file a written reconsideration request with the Office of the Registrar of Corporations within 14 business days of rejection. The request must detail the grounds for distinctiveness and, if applicable, evidence of ministerial approval for any sensitive token. If the Registrar upholds the rejection, an appeal may be filed with the High Court of the Marshall Islands within 30 days of the reconsideration decision. All government fees are non-refundable unless the initial rejection is reversed on appeal.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible. A non-resident Business Corporation must maintain a registered office in the Marshall Islands through a licensed registered agent. The virtual office model is accepted; the physical street address of the registered agent serves as the statutory address. No physical premises, local staff, warehousing, or commercial substance is required to be present in the Marshall Islands for non-resident status, provided the company remains outside the domestic tax net and does not carry on trade or business within the islands.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low. The risk of an unannounced physical inspection at the remote operations premises (e.g., a print-on-demand warehouse or home office) is less than 1% annually absent suspicious activity. The licensed registered agent's premises in the Marshall Islands may be inspected by the FIU or the Registrar during routine AML/CFT compliance visits, with an approximate annual probability of 5%.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name reservation and statutory incorporation filing fee (Business Corporation, non-resident)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the Business Corporations Act and Schedule of Fees (Title 51, RMI Code)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent and registered office service fee for the first calendar year
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for non-resident corporate compliance services

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT and UBO due diligence verification (including PEP and sanctions screening) for one natural-person beneficial owner
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registered agent or independent compliance firm engaged for the filing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for standard-risk, individual beneficial owner screening

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and consular legalization of passport, proof of address, and bank letter
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public and Marshall Islands Embassy/Consulate
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing official consular fee and notarial fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed registered agent or corporate services provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for standard corporate records preparation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Post-registration Certificate of Good Standing (expedite fee and standard issuance)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff for certified extracts and certificates

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act 1990, as amended (the 'BCA'), codified at Title 27 of the Marshall Islands Revised Code (MIRC) — formation, Articles of Incorporation, Certificate of Incorporation, registered office and registered agent, director/officer, and annual franchise tax provisions; read together with the Income Tax Act 1989 (Non-Resident Domestic Corporation status), the Business License Act 2007, and the Foreign Investment Business License Act 1997.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Corporate Registry Division, Office of the Attorney General, Republic of the Marshall Islands, Majuro (filings accepted at the Majuro registry counter or submitted by a licensed RMI registered agent through the registry's electronic channel).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (statutory instrument signed by the incorporator, accepted by the RMI registered agent, stamped by the Registrar, and evidenced by the Certificate of Incorporation).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital and no escrow requirement. The BCA permits one or more shares with or without par value, payable in cash or any lawful consideration. The proposed capitalization is 100,000 Common Shares at US$0.001 par value, credited as fully paid and non-assessable under the First Board Resolution, without any deposit, escrow, or bank confirmation at filing. An annual franchise tax of at least USD 100 is payable to the Registrar with the annual report.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF [COMPANY NAME], A MARSHALL ISLANDS BUSINESS CORPORATION. WHEREAS the Articles were filed and the Certificate of Incorporation issued; RESOLVED, that: (1) the founding shareholder's subscription for 100,000 Common Shares at US$0.001 par value is approved and issued fully paid and non-assessable, no escrow being required; (2) the registered office at [Registered Agent], Majuro, RMI, and the appointment of such registered agent are ratified; (3) [Name] is elected President, [Name] Treasurer, and [Name] Secretary, each with full authority to execute payment-platform, bank account, and licensing documents; (4) the corporate seal and stock book are adopted. The Resolution was unanimously adopted by the sole director and is effective immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Corporate Registry Division, Office of the Attorney General, Majuro, RMI (name clearance forms are routed through the licensed RMI registered agent).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the name reservation form with one primary and two alternate corporate names, each ending with 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Limited', or an approved abbreviation. The Registrar searches the corporate register and issues a name clearance certificate (valid for 60 days) if the proposed name is not confusingly similar to an existing domestic or foreign registered name.
required_dossiers: Letter of authorization to the RMI registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused as confusingly similar, the applicant may submit the written consent of the existing name holder, choose an alternate cleared name, or request an administrative review by the Registrar within 14 days of the refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Articles of Incorporation and Bylaws
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Incorporator in coordination with the licensed RMI registered agent and a notary public (for signature acknowledgment).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation stating the cleared corporate name, the registered office address and registered agent in the RMI, the authorized share structure (100,000 Common Shares, US$0.001 par value), the permitted business purpose (unrestricted lawful purposes including ISIC 4791 print-on-demand retailing), and the initial director's name. Execute the Articles before a notary, adopt the initial Bylaws, and obtain the registered agent's signed acceptance of appointment.
required_dossiers: Notarized consent of the initial director
KYC documents: passport, proof of residential address, and CV of director/shareholder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar objects to any Article provision, the incorporator may execute a corrective amendment or the board may adopt a restatement; de minimis drafting defects are curable within 15 days without loss of filing priority.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Marshall Islands Revenue and Taxation Division, Ministry of Finance, Majuro; no statutory national e-filing portal for foreign non-resident entities, filings are submitted on paper to the Revenue Office
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A non-resident Business Corporation (MH_BC) is not required to obtain a Marshall Islands TIN unless it begins deriving RMI-source gross revenue. If registration becomes necessary, file the corporate registration certificate, certificate of good standing from the RMI Registrar, and completed RMI Gross Revenue Tax registration form with the Revenue and Taxation Division, obtain a GRT number, and then file quarterly returns; there is no check-the-box or advance tax ruling step
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. The RMI has no check-the-box entity classification election, no hybrid mismatch election, and no branch-equivalent election; the tax status is determined solely by residence and RMI-source revenue activity

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT/GST; RMI has a Gross Revenue Tax (GRT) on RMI-source business gross revenue
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable for VAT/GST. Under the RMI Gross Revenue Tax, a business holding a valid business license must file and remit GRT where gross revenue exceeds the periodically set small-exemption threshold; a non-resident POD apparel seller with no physical operating presence in RMI has no VAT registration threshold because no VAT regime exists
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None. There is no real-time fiscal clearance, no API integration mandate, no digital stamping obligation, and no certified electronic invoicing requirement for business-to-consumer POD sales; ordinary commercial invoices and payment processor receipts satisfy documentary requirements

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable under a VAT system because the RMI does not impose VAT/GST on exports. For GRT purposes, sales of custom-printed and POD merchandise to customers located outside the Marshall Islands are treated as non-RMI-source gross revenue and are outside the GRT base if the seller establishes that the goods were shipped directly abroad (or supplied as offshore services) from an RMI trade or business; no zero-rating claim or refund mechanism exists because there is no output tax against which input tax can be credited
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Marshall Islands Customs) evidencing direct foreign shipment
POD order record, shipping manifest, and Bill of Lading or last-mile carrier proof of export
Inward Remittance Certificate or payment processor settlement record identifying the foreign customer and foreign currency remittance
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Although no VAT zero-rating clawback exists, a false GRT exclusion for purported export sales is treated as underreporting taxable gross revenue. Penalties include a minimum late-payment and underpayment penalty of 10% of the unpaid tax, interest at the statutory annual rate, criminal fines for fraudulent returns, and retroactive assessment of the full GRT plus penalty for a period of up to six years from the original return due date

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of the Marshall Islands (CBMI), established under the Central Bank Act 2018 and operational since 2019 as the RMI banking-licensing and AML/CFT supervisory authority, succeeding the former Banking Commission and the banking supervision unit of the Ministry of Finance. The U.S. dollar is the sole legal tender under the RMI Constitution and the Compact of Free Association; no RMI currency is issued, no independent monetary policy exists, and the de facto monetary anchor is the U.S. Federal Reserve System. CBMI administers the Banking Act 1991 (as amended) and does not operate any exchange-control or foreign-exchange-approval regime. There is no separate foreign-exchange administration in the RMI.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full de jure convertibility in both current and capital accounts. The RMI maintains no foreign-exchange-control statute, no capital-transaction licensing, no profit-remittance restriction, and no domestic currency; all payments are USD-denominated. A non-resident Business Corporation, which is tax-exempt under the RMI Income Tax Act, may freely pay dividends, repay shareholder loans, and transfer trading proceeds abroad without CBMI authorization. Current-account items (trade payments, platform settlements, supplier disbursements) and capital-account items (equity injections, intercompany loans, acquisition proceeds) are equally unrestricted. Practical hurdles arise only at the correspondent-bank layer: USD wires clear through U.S. banks that apply OFAC screening, source-of-funds review, and UBO validation; therefore the operative condition for convertibility and profit remittance is a complete, current treasury KYC file comprising registry extracts, a beneficial-ownership schedule, a no-bearer-shares declaration, and platform-derived transaction evidence. Withholding taxes on outbound remittances are nil for the non-resident exempt BC, but the paying bank may request the RMI tax-exempt certification and a board resolution evidencing the distribution.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None applicable. The RMI imposes no statutory surrender ratio, no repatriation timeline, and no mandatory conversion obligation on export receipts; POD e-commerce proceeds in USD are freely held in the RMI or offshore. In practice, banks expect USD inflows from Stripe/PayPal settlement or card acquirers to be traceable to genuine merchandise sales: retain platform payout reports, daily settlement advices, invoices, and POD fulfilment records for a rolling five-year period to withstand enhanced due-diligence triggered by high-frequency small-value credits.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: USD Operational Settlement Account for non-resident exempt BC; restricted product availability typical for this profile (no treasury sweeps or commercial LC issuance; escrow unnecessary because no statutory minimum capital applies)

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act (registered-agent facilitated)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 60 calendar days after the anniversary of incorporation (anniversary-based deadline; no calendar-year deadline for non-resident BCs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing blocks certification of good standing; a 10% late monetary penalty is assessed; two consecutive years of default trigger administrative strike-off/dissolution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Franchise Tax / government renewal fee (paid with the Annual Report)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations (remitted to the Marshall Islands National Treasury)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due simultaneously with Annual Report, not later than 60 days after the incorporation anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unpaid franchise tax accrues interest/penalty from the deadline; continued non-payment for two consecutive annual periods exposes the corporation to administrative dissolution and loss of legal existence.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent and Registered Office renewal confirmation (continuation of Marshall Islands address and agent mandate)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Marshall Islands registered agent; a copy is lodged with the Registrar if the agent or office changes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually before the Annual Report; in practice at the incorporation anniversary, or immediately on any change of agent/office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Termination of the registered agent results in Registrar warning and administrative dissolution if no replacement agent is appointed within 30 days.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual AML / UBO confirmation to the registered agent (beneficial-ownership record update)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered agent under Marshall Islands AML/CFT obligations; not a public filing with the Registrar
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the annual anniversary date and whenever significant shareholding/beneficial ownership changes occur
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Inaccurate or incomplete beneficial-ownership records expose the corporation and directors to AML/CFT fines and prevent the registered agent from certifying the Annual Report.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory revenue, asset, or employee threshold imposes an audit for a non-resident Marshall Islands business corporation. A statutory or contractual audit arises only when the corporation is a securities issuer or exchange-listed, when a shareholder or the Registrar validly demands an audit, when a court orders it, or when an e-commerce/payment processor or lender requires audited financial statements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Marshall Islands BCCA does not prescribe a mandatory financial-statement framework; books and records must fairly reflect transactions in English or a translatable form. If audited financial statements are prepared or required, the covenants typically adopt IFRS or US GAAP by written resolution.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Marshall Islands imposes no public annual UBO registry filing. The company must provide its registered agent with current beneficial ownership and control information before the Annual Report is filed. Share transfers are effective only upon recording in the Register of Members and require directors' confirmation; the registered agent annually verifies that the Register of Members, register of directors, and AML/CFT records are materially accurate.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 400 – USD 800 per annum (licensed Marshall Islands registered agent and office)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,000 – USD 8,000 if an audit is triggered; otherwise USD 0 for a non-resident BC with no statutory audit requirement

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% effective exposure for the non-resident Business Corporation. The Marshall Islands Income Tax Act 1989 (as amended) charges tax only on gross income sourced within the Marshall Islands; a non-resident corporation is chargeable at 21% of such RMI-source gross income. A POD custom-merchandise retailing BC selling to non-RMI customers through Stripe and PayPal generates no RMI-source income and is therefore outside the charge to tax. No net-loss carryforward is recognized because the non-resident tax base is gross revenue, not net income.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: De facto tax-exempt zone for non-resident BCs: no taxation of foreign-source trading income, no capital gains tax, no branch profits tax, no minimum corporate income tax, no annual wealth tax, and no RMI withholding tax on outbound dividends, interest, or royalties. The BC is also outside the RMI social security system for non-resident employees.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: RMI Corporate Gross Revenue Tax Return (issued upon individual registration with the RMI Revenue and Taxation Office, Majuro; no separate published form number for non-residents). Portal: RMI Revenue and Taxation Office e-services with paper filing accepted.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (tax year is the calendar year ending 31 December).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: No filing obligation arises for a non-resident BC without RMI-source income. A non-resident BC that derives RMI-source gross income must register and file within 120 days after the 31 December year-end; extensions require prior Revenue approval.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 1 - Gross revenue derived from sources within the Marshall Islands
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Aggregate gross revenue attributable to RMI customers or RMI-based services; for POD retail, this is normally nil unless customers are physically located in the RMI.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter zero and attach a brief explanation of the offshore operating model if the Revenue Office has issued a filing request; the offshore BC should otherwise refrain from unnecessary filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-resident corporate rate of 21% applied to Line 1 gross revenue.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Not applicable where Line 1 is nil; no apportionment formula exists for partial RMI activity, so any RMI-source revenue triggers the 21% charge on that gross amount.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 3 - Credits and prior RMI withholding
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: RMI withholding credits, if any, from RMI payors that withheld tax on payments to the BC.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Credits are allowable only where the RMI payor actually withheld and remitted; the offshore BC should obtain a withholding certificate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certification of accuracy signed by a director or officer of the BC.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident director may sign; knowingly false declarations expose the signatory to criminal penalties.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Willful failure to file and pay on RMI-source income: assessment of the 21% gross revenue tax plus statutory interest and additions; criminal prosecution under the Income Tax Act may lead to a fine of up to USD 5,000 and imprisonment of up to 3 years. For the wholly offshore POD BC, no failure penalty exposure arises because no return is due.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Report of a Business Corporation filed under section 97 of the Business Corporations Act, submitted electronically by the licensed registered agent through the RMI Registrar of Corporations e-registry agent portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual, in the month of the anniversary of incorporation.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due no later than the last day of the month corresponding to the anniversary of incorporation; for example, a corporation incorporated on 15 March is due no later than 31 March of each year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact registered name of the BC as shown on the Certificate of Incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Completed by the registered agent from registry records; no change can be made without a separate amendment filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 2 - Registered office in the Marshall Islands
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical street address of the registered office in Majuro maintained by the registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A PO Box alone is insufficient; the office is the statutory address for service of legal process.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and address of the RMI-licensed corporate service provider acting for the BC.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent must be a licensed RMI registered agent and is the primary interface with the Registrar for all filings.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names and addresses of the directors and of the president, secretary, and treasurer or equivalent officers.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident individuals are fully permitted; there is no RMI residency, nationality, or tax identification requirement for directors or officers.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 5 - Authorized capital and issued shares
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized share capital, par value, and issued and outstanding shares used to compute the annual listing fee.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No minimum capital requirement; non-resident shareholders may hold 100% of the issued shares.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 6 - Annual listing fee and certification
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation of the annual listing fee per the BCA fee schedule and electronic certification by an officer or director.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Fee is calculated by the registered agent (minimum USD 50, capped at USD 10,000); beneficial ownership details are maintained privately by the agent for AML purposes and are not filed with the public annual report.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts a 10% surcharge on the unpaid annual listing fee. Continued non-payment and non-filing may result in revocation of the Certificate of Incorporation by the Registrar, loss of the corporate limited-liability shield, and reinstatement only upon payment of arrears and court or Registrar approval.
